reason: I have run two outlets on my register for years and I count the drawer myself every night, so I know where every rupee is. I don't see why I should pay ten thousand and then five hundred every month to move my staff onto phones and a check-in that tells them I am watching them.
objection: My stylists have been with me a long time; a selfie check-in and an app watching every bill will make them feel I don't trust them, and if they don't use it properly the numbers are useless and I am back to my register anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Let me try it free for a month at my second branch, without the attendance check-in, and show me it catches cash my register misses.
